_doc: Level-owned lines for Scrapheap Junction and the shared level kit (bs.level.*). Same shape as lines_index.json (id -> who/text). LevelKit.register_lines merges them into VOManager at level load.

bs.scrapheap.sign_mast.text:
OMNISCRAP BILLING ANTENNA
NOW BILLING: EVERYONE

bs.scrapheap.sign_works.text:
SORTING LINE
YOUR BELONGINGS, IN MOTION

bs.scrapheap.sign_hull.text:
THE WRECK THAT STARTED IT
CREW BILLED FOR THE CRASH

bs.scrapheap.sign_boneyard.text:
THE BONEYARD
Every ship that ever missed a payment

bs.scrapheap.ship_booted.text: It's booted, Bolt. Section 12-B. Our ride off this rock is that dead freight teleporter past the Compaction Lot.

bs.scrapheap.power_sub.text: The wreck's cell is feeding the teleporter

bs.scrapheap.uplink_sub.text: The billing dish now bills the teleporter

bs.scrapheap.hint_mallet.text: Mallet grabbed! F to swing. Hold AIM and press F to THROW it at yellow-black plates.

bs.scrapheap.hint_latch.text: That pit lid has a yellow-black latch. Throw the mallet at it!

bs.scrapheap.hint_hover.text: Hold JUMP in the air to HOVER: float from the crates to the garage roof, then SLAM down.

bs.scrapheap.hint_reverser.text: Hit a yellow lever with a mallet throw to reverse its belt for 8 seconds.

bs.scrapheap.hint_clamps.text: Three bearing clamps lock the dish. Free each one with a mallet throw.

bs.scrapheap.rusty_idle.text: Mutts quiet, sandwiches home. Go get your garage back, kid. And mine. I never had one, but go get it anyway.

bs.scrapheap.gasket_idle.text: Lights on, sky clear. Soup's on too, hon. Ninety percent bolts, ten percent love.

bs.scrapheap.mailbox_bark.text: "You found my MAILBOX! Teeth marks and all. Still no mail. Still mine."

bs.scrapheap.jar_sub.text: The ledger-keeper won't mind. He will. He'll write it down.

bs.scrapheap.qhint_q1a.text: Hear that? Distant barking. Somebody's Scrap Mutts are unionising.

bs.scrapheap.qhint_q1b.text: Mustard. Faint, vacuum-sealed, unmistakable. A sandwich is near.

bs.scrapheap.qhint_q1c.text: Something's humming at sixty hertz. That's a fuse, or a very confident bee.

bs.scrapheap.qhint_q1d.text: Wing-flaps overhead. Vultures. They appraise everything, Bolt. Including you.
